verses.text: Keep track of the month of Abib and celebrate Passover for Yahweh your God. It was in Abib that Yahweh your God brought you out of Egypt at night.
Offer Yahweh your God the Passover sacrifice from the flock or herd, at the place Yahweh chooses for his name to dwell.

Don’t eat bread made with yeast with it. For seven days eat bread made without yeast, the bread of hardship, because you left Egypt in a hurry. Remember the day you left Egypt for as long as you live.
For seven days there must be no yeast anywhere in your territory. Don’t leave any of the meat you sacrifice on the first evening overnight until morning.
You can’t offer the Passover sacrifice in just any town Yahweh your God gives you.
Offer it where Yahweh your God chooses for his name to dwell. Do it in the evening at sunset, at the time of year when you came out of Egypt.
Roast and eat it at the place Yahweh your God chooses. In the morning, head back to your tents.
Eat bread made without yeast for six days. On day seven, hold a solemn gathering for Yahweh your God. Do no work that day.
Count off seven weeks from the first time you put the sickle to the standing grain.
Celebrate the Festival of Weeks for Yahweh your God. Bring a gift you give freely, in keeping with how much Yahweh your God has blessed you.

Celebrate before Yahweh your God in the place he chooses for his name to dwell. Celebrate with your sons, daughters, male and female servants, and the Levites, foreigners, children without fathers, and widows who live among you.
Remember you were a slave in Egypt. Be careful to follow these laws.
Celebrate the Festival of Booths for seven days after bringing in what’s come from your threshing floor and your winepress.
Celebrate at your festival with your sons, daughters, male and female servants, and the Levites, foreigners, children without fathers, and widows in your towns.
Celebrate the festival for Yahweh your God for seven days at the place he chooses. Yahweh your God will bless your harvest and all your work, so you’ll be full of joy.

Three times a year all your males must appear before Yahweh your God at the place he chooses: at the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the Festival of Weeks, and the Festival of Booths. Nobody should show up before Yahweh empty-handed.
Each person should give what they can, in keeping with what Yahweh your God has given them.
Appoint judges and officers for your tribes in every town Yahweh your God gives you. They must judge the people fairly.
Don’t twist justice, play favorites, or take bribes. A bribe blinds even wise people and twists the words of people who do right.
Go after justice and nothing else, so you’ll live and inherit the land Yahweh your God gives you.
Don’t plant any tree as an Asherah beside the altar you build for Yahweh your God.
Don’t set up a sacred stone for yourselves either. Yahweh your God hates that.
